propositions: Add an opt-in --live-visibility flag to rebar bridge fsck that performs a read-only, advisory live visibility check on mapped project keys and legacy_default without mutating bridge state or altering exit code

When JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, and JIRA_API_TOKEN credentials are absent or incomplete and no probe is injected, the visibility check emits a skipped verdict with reason=missing_credentials and does not fail or call the probe
The mapped-project visibility logic must reuse the shared helper access_check.check_mapped_project_visibility (from ticket D) rather than hand-rolling a duplicate existence check
The default rebar bridge fsck output (without --live-visibility flag) must have an unchanged JSON schema with exactly unknown_event_types, binding_drift, and store_integrity fields
The --live-visibility advisory results are rendered to stderr in both text and --output json modes without altering the stdout JSON contract or schema
Core rebar doctor command must remain Jira-free with no reachable imports of reconciler or [agents] optional extras from src/rebar/_commands/doctor.py
